content: शुद्धिः [शुध्-क्तिन्] .²1 Purity, cleanness. .²2 Brightness, lustre; मुक्तागुणशुद्धयोऽपि (चन्द्रपादाः) <ls>R. 16. 18</ls>. .²3 Sanctity, holiness; तीर्थाभिषेकजां शुद्धिमादधाना महीक्षितः <ls>R. 1. 85</ls>. .²4 Purification, expiation, atonement, expiatory act; शरीरत्यागमात्रेण शुद्धिलाभममन्यत <ls>R. 12. 10</ls>. .²5 A purificatory or expiatory rite. .²6 Paying off or clearing (of expenses). .²7 Retaliation, requital. .²8 Acquittal, innocence (established by trial). .²9 Truth, accuracy, correctness. .²10 Rectification, correction. .²11 Subtraction. .²12 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²13 (in <ab>Arith.</ab>) Leaving no remainder.
